scope: Strictly disjoint Gaia sources in recorded Epsilon Indi D3 pair; the shared pair is not an independent detector/systematics sample.

catalog_selection.allwise_quality: W1/W2 ph_qual A or B, cc_flags00, var_flg digits0or1, ext_flg0, W1/W2 SNR>=10
catalog_selection.allwise_neighbors: All returned source-catalog entries, no magnitude cut; unresolved/subthreshold blends remain possible
catalog_selection.ordering: numeric Gaia source_id ascending; lock first20 catalog-eligible; never replace flux/quality failures
catalog_selection.proper_motion: Propagate controls and Gaia neighbors with measured PM to both FITS epochs; AllWISE match at2010.5. Missing neighbor PM retains catalog position and is counted as a completeness limitation.
catalog_selection.field: Entire31arcsec neighborhood must lie within requested .2degree TAN square in both exposures

methods.annulus: Same native pixel-center annulus3<=r<=5, excludeSOURCE/hard/warning, median; N>=10 mandatory
methods.unmodeled: Detector/plane covariance, aperture correction, PSF variations, unresolved companions and infrared variability; no absolute calibrated-flux claim

failure_policy: No threshold relaxation, no residual-based rejection, no replacement of unavailable inputs. Fewer than3 controls or failed prerequisite => insufficient, not pass.
independence: Excluded all Phase3controlIDs; no flux of new controls has been inspected. Samefield residual systematics may persist; validation does not generalize to all bands.
